newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle market Monday roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle market Monday roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade was at a virtual standstill on Monday, USDA said. Prices on slaughter steers and heifers not fully established, few steers dressed basis steady. Buyer inquiry limited, most not bidding, just taking inventory.
Seller interest minimal. Asking prices $70.00 per cwt on a live basis and $112.00 or more dressed.
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered ( paid on hot carcass weights).
Slaughter Steers - Few Select and Choice 2-3 1200 lbs 112.00.
For The Week - 1,000 Sm Pd Lst Wk - 1,900 Sm Pd Lst Yr - 500
